Dense-grid approximation to multivariate functional trajectory PCA

Source: R/trajectory-grid-pca.R
aqt_trajectory_grid_pca.Rd

Each scoped fish path is independently registered to 0..1 relative time, linearly resampled to a common grid and decomposed by ordinary PCA on concatenated X/Y(/Z) grid coordinates. This is an explicitly finite-grid PCA approximation, NOT sparse FPCA, continuous functional mixed models, temporal causality inference, or a qualified EyeTrajectories backend. Starting-position centering optionally removes constant translation. Irregular source sampling is accepted only when no gap exceeds max_gap_s.

Usage

aqt_trajectory_grid_pca(
  tracks,
  n_grid = 60L,
  n_components = 2L,
  origin = c("start", "absolute"),
  max_gap_s = Inf
)

Arguments

tracks

Validated aqt_tracks with >=3 complete scoped fish paths.

n_grid

Integer common relative-time grid size, 5..1000.

n_components

Number of principal components, 1..min(n_fish-1,p).

origin

start (subtract initial XYZ) or absolute coordinates.

max_gap_s

Largest source interval allowed for interpolation.

Value

aqt_grid_pca containing scores, mode curves, mean path, relative-time grid, and variance explained.
